participation.context: Said the eight lines held, and that he was not proud of them.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Came through the dry place once and apologised to nobody.
participation.name: Richard Cowley

participation.context: Refused to call the afternoon a mending, and would not shut a bag on it.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Counted once against Tuesday's four, and would not add them into a new play.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

participation.context: Had a doublet that met, and would not call that a victory.
participation.name: John Sincler

story.body: You kept the eight lines and refused a triumph. Cowley had one clean pass and no apology. The company broke without calling the book mended.

title: Played the Knave, and Cowley came through the dry place once
